delivery_zones_eta_valid.name: delivery_zones_eta_valid
delivery_zones_eta_valid.value: ("delivery_zones"."eta_min_days" IS NULL OR "delivery_zones"."eta_min_days" >= 0) AND ("delivery_zones"."eta_max_days" IS NULL OR "delivery_zones"."eta_min_days" IS NULL OR "delivery_zones"."eta_max_days" >= "delivery_zones"."eta_min_days")

discount_codes_window.name: discount_codes_window
discount_codes_window.value: "discount_codes"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "discount_codes"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "discount_codes"."ends_at" > "discount_codes"."starts_at"

product_images_dims_pos.name: product_images_dims_pos
product_images_dims_pos.value: ("product_images"."width" IS NULL AND "product_images"."height" IS NULL) OR ("product_images"."width" IS NOT NULL AND "product_images"."height" IS NOT NULL AND "product_images"."width" > 0 AND "product_images"."height" > 0)

push_subscriptions_owner.name: push_subscriptions_owner
push_subscriptions_owner.value: ("push_subscriptions"."audience" = 'seller' AND "push_subscriptions"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "push_subscriptions"."store_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("push_subscriptions"."audience" = 'customer' AND "push_subscriptions"."order_id" IS NOT NULL)
